regime-summary:
<style>
  .regime-summary-wrap{
    --rs-divider: rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    --rs-head-bg: #095972;
    --rs-head-text: #ffffff;
    --rs-text: rgba(0,0,0,0.88);
    --rs-row-white: #ffffff;
    --rs-row-alt: #F5F8F9;
    font-family: "ABC Diatype", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    max-width: 1100px;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .regime-summary-table{
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--rs-divider);
  }
  .regime-summary-table__grid{
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.85fr 2.15fr;
  }
  .regime-summary-table__head{
    padding: 18px;
    background: var(--rs-head-bg);
    color: var(--rs-head-text);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .regime-summary-table__head:not(:last-child){
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }
  .regime-summary-table__cell{
    padding: 18px;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--rs-text);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--rs-divider);
  }
  .regime-summary-table__cell:not(.col-last){
    border-right: 1px solid var(--rs-divider);
  }
  .regime-summary-table__cell.row--white{ background: var(--rs-row-white); }
  .regime-summary-table__cell.row--alt{ background: var(--rs-row-alt); }
  .regime-summary-table__cell.cat-strong{
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  @media (max-width: 767px){
    .regime-summary-table{
      transform: scale(0.94);
      transform-origin: top left;
      width: 106%;
    }
    .regime-summary-table__cell,
    .regime-summary-table__head{
      padding: 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
  }
  @media (max-width: 390px){
    .regime-summary-table{
      transform: scale(0.9);
      width: 111%;
    }
  }
</style>

positioning-table:
<style>
  :root{
    --pos-divider: rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    --pos-head-bg: #095972;
    --pos-head-text: #ffffff;
    --pos-text: rgba(0,0,0,0.88);
    --pos-row-white: #ffffff;
    --pos-row-parent: #F5F8F9;
  }
  .positioning-table-wrap{
    font-family: "ABC Diatype", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    max-width: 1100px;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .positioning-table{
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
  }
  .positioning-table__grid{
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 3.4fr;
  }
  .positioning-table__head{
    padding: 18px;
    background: var(--pos-head-bg);
    color: var(--pos-head-text);
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .positioning-table__head:not(:last-child){
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }
  .positioning-table__parent-name{
    grid-column: 1;
    padding: 18px;
    background: var(--pos-row-parent);
    color: var(--pos-text);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 15px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
  }
  .positioning-table__parent-mid{
    grid-column: 2;
    padding: 18px;
    background: var(--pos-row-parent);
    color: var(--pos-text);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 15px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
  }
  .positioning-table__parent-rationale{
    grid-column: 3;
    padding: 18px;
    background: var(--pos-row-parent);
    color: var(--pos-text);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
  }
  .positioning-table__cell{
    padding: 18px;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--pos-text);
    background: var(--pos-row-white);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
  }
  .positioning-table__cell--name{
    font-weight: 700;
    padding-left: 38px;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
  }
  .positioning-table__cell--mid{
    border-right: 1px solid var(--pos-divider);
  }
  @media (max-width: 767px){
    .positioning-table{
      transform: scale(0.94);
      transform-origin: top left;
      width: 106%;
    }
    .positioning-table__cell,
    .positioning-table__head,
    .positioning-table__parent-name,
    .positioning-table__parent-mid,
    .positioning-table__parent-rationale{
      padding: 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .positioning-table__cell--name{
      padding-left: 22px;
    }
  }
  @media (max-width: 390px){
    .positioning-table{
      transform: scale(0.9);
      width: 111%;
    }
  }
</style>
